text:
Maya: DeployBot just posted an automated alert for canary group 'search-embed-v3' — some pods are reporting runtime=2.14.0 while the canary target is 2.15.0. It suggested a pin for the affected cohort.
DeployBot: [automated] ALERT: runtime_compat_mismatch detected (canary: eu-west-2, cohort: search-embed-v3). Suggested action: pin-runtime 2.14.0 for cohort until investigation. See /deploybot/logs/1766666000. :warning:
Eli: ugh, ok. Is this the same metric drift we saw last week or a new kernel path?
Sanjay: looks like a kernel-selection edge — kv-cache path fallback triggered on longer sequences. Only shows up on a subset of a100 instances.
Lina: can you paste the subset IDs? I want to cross-check with the nightly stress runs.
Sanjay: copying output from deploy check: ```
affected_instances: [a100-eu-3, a100-eu-7]
runtime_reported: 2.14.0
expected_canary: 2.15.0
error_signature: kvcache_fallback_longseq
telemetry_span: 2026-03-23T10:13:00Z-10:18:00Z
```
Maya: thanks. DeployBot suggested a temporary pin — but we already have running traffic split. Do we want to accept pin for just the two instances (pin-bridge) or pin cohort-wide?
Eli: prefer a narrow "pin-bridge" where the request router sends affected hosts only the older runtime variant. That avoids rollback for all canary traffic. But need a fast rollback plan if unhandled.
QA-Bot: quick smoke results from last deploy: no regression for shortseq, but longseq QA tests show 2-3% fail rate on those hosts. Failing prompts: truncation differences.
Lina: that matches the reproducer I had — long prompts hit a different kernel. If we pin just those pods, we'll need to update the release notes and the rollforward docs so SRE/Customer Success know which cohort saw degraded longseq.
Maya: decision proposal: enact pin-bridge (cohort routing change) for a 1-hour mitigation window, flip a telemetry flag, and run additional longseq tests. If no improvement, escalate to rollback of canary to 2.14.0 cluster-wide.
Eli: +1 to that flow, also add an alert if longseq errors >1% in the next 30m. Who can execute the pin-bridge?
Sanjay: I can fire the routing change. Command I will run: ```
deployctl routing set-cohort-pin --cohort=search-embed-v3 --instances=a100-eu-3,a100-eu-7 --runtime=2.14.0 --ttl=3600
```
Maya: please include a note for the release notes and the canary timeline: "temporary routing pin to prevent longseq degradation on subset of canary hosts". Also add an internal note: "do not unpin until QA signoff or rollback executed."
DeployBot: [automated] ACTION: pin-bridge request queued by Sanjay. Run id: rb-1766666000-01. ETA apply ~2s.
Sanjay: applied, routing reports: ```
rb-1766666000-01: applied
route_changes: 2 hosts pinned to runtime 2.14.0
canary_split: unchanged (10% traffic)
verification: routing propagation OK
```
Maya: added a short release-notes blurb in the docs PR and pinged CS. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pulls/3289 
Lina: QA running extended longseq suite now, will post results in 20m.
Eli: I'll watch p99 latency and error_budget in the next 30m. If we see regressions elsewhere, we rollback.
QA-Bot: short update: first 10 longseq tests failed 1/10 on a100-eu-3, consistent with earlier. Running another 100 now.
Maya: status check in 30m. If stable, schedule a staged unpin tomorrow morning during the normal change window and include a note to monitor heatmap for kernel fallbacks.
Sanjay: logging the rollback plan here: 1) rollback canary to runtime 2.14.0 cluster-wide via deployctl rollback --canary-id=rb-1766666000-01 2) open incident channel and notify CS 3) revert via canary re-deploy to 2.14.0 and re-run critical evals.
Lina: also adding a follow-up action: engineering should validate kernel selection heuristics under longseq load for next sprint.
Maya: ok, thanks team. running watch. :eyes: 
Eli: noted. tagging @oncall for visibility.
DeployBot: [automated] TELEMETRY FLAG: longseq_error_watch=true for rb-1766666000-01. Alerts configured for >1% over 30m.
QA-Bot: final interim: 100 longseq tests -> 92 pass, 8 fail concentrated on a100-eu-3. Will attach log snippets to PR.
Maya: decision: keep pin-bridge in place, widen monitoring, update release notes and schedule unpin in 24h pending signoff. If failures increase, execute rollback plan.
Eli: copy. I'll prep the rollback command set and a postmortem template in case we need it.
Sanjay: all done from infra side. Moving to watchlist.
Lina: filing a ticket for kernel heuristic eval: INC-2026-091.
Maya: closing thread for now but will update if anything changes. Thanks. :thumbsup:
